dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, $item.attachments.@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf").@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url") AND NOT (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf")).@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url") OR (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf")).@count == $item.attachments.@count).@count == 1
